description: This source file defines a utility class 'ReferenceCleaner' and inner classes for managing references (Soft, Phantom, Weak) with automatic cleanup via a dedicated background thread. It facilitates resource management and cleanup for objects using Java reference types.

classes.name: ReferenceCleaner
classes.description: Utility class that manages cleanup of references with an internal background thread.

classes.name: ReferenceCleaner.CleanerThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Thread, responsible for removing references from the queue and invoking their cleanup.

classes.name: ReferenceCleaner.Removable
classes.description: Interface defining the 'remove' method for cleanup actions.

classes.name: ReferenceCleaner.Soft
classes.description: Abstract class extending SoftReference, implementing Removable to manage soft references.

classes.name: ReferenceCleaner.Phantom
classes.description: Abstract class extending PhantomReference, implementing Removable for phantom references.

classes.name: ReferenceCleaner.Weak
classes.description: Abstract class extending WeakReference, implementing Removable for weak references.

methods.name: stopRunning
methods.description: Stops the CleanerThread loop by setting keepRunning to false.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop of CleanerThread; removes references from queue and calls their remove method.
